snippet.title: Techno Prank - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
An immersive simulator of a phone techno-prankster.
Find the victims phone numbers, communicate with them using their own phrases and put on a show, pitting them against each other!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1571780/Techno_Prank/
Discord: https://discord.gg/34SzCPRKUD
